basic_details.job_title: Baloda Bazar District Court Recruitment 2026 - Apply Offline for 18 Stenographer and Assistant Posts
basic_details.short_information: Baloda Bazar District Court has released an official notification for the recruitment of 18 Stenographer Grade-3 and Assistant Grade-3 Posts. Interested and eligible candidates can apply Offline by sending the application form to the official address. The last date to submit the application is 14-08-2026.

age_limit.details: Minimum Age: 18 years Maximum Age: 30 years Age Relaxation: Up to 40 years for Chhattisgarh domicile; 5 years for SC/ST/OBC; 10 years for women; other relaxations as per rules; maximum 45 years with all relaxations.

qualification.education_qualification: Graduate from recognized university, Shorthand and Typing qualification from recognized board, Computer diploma or knowledge, Knowledge of Chhattisgarh local language
qualification.details: Stenographer Grade-3 (Hindi): Graduate from recognized university; Hindi Shorthand and Typing from recognized board; Computer knowledge in Hindi typing; Knowledge of computer applications; Knowledge of Chhattisgarh local language. Stenographer Grade-3 (English): Graduate from recognized university; English Shorthand and Typing from recognized board; Computer knowledge in English typing; Knowledge of computer applications; Knowledge of Chhattisgarh local language. Assistant Grade-3 (Nishpadan Lipik, Sakshya Lekhak and Aadeshika Lekhak): Graduate from recognized university; One year computer diploma from recognized board/university; Knowledge of Hindi and English typing on computer; Knowledge of Chhattisgarh local language.

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for Baloda Bazar District Court Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: balodabazar.dcourts.gov.in.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 14-08-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Baloda Bazar District Court recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Baloda Bazar District Court Stenographer Grade-3 and Assistant Grade-3 posts is 14th August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Stenographer Grade-3 and Assistant Grade-3 posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 18 vacancies released by the Baloda Bazar District Court for Stenographer Grade-3 and Assistant Grade-3 positions.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum and maximum age limit for these posts?
faq.answer: The minimum age limit is 18 years and the maximum age limit is 30 years for all the posts announced by the Baloda Bazar District Court.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for Assistant Grade-3 posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must be graduates from a recognized university and possess a one-year computer diploma from a recognized board or university. Knowledge of Hindi and English typing on a computer and the local language of Chhattisgarh is also required.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General, OBC, SC, ST) in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary structure for Stenographer Grade-3?
faq.answer: The salary for Stenographer Grade-3 posts will be as per Level-7, which ranges from ₹28,700 to ₹91,300 per month.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for Stenographer Grade-3 and Assistant Grade-3 posts includes a Written Test and a Skill Test.

faq.question: Q8. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for the Baloda Bazar District Court recruitment is Offline. Candidates need to send their application form to the official address.

faq.question: Q9. Does the Baloda Bazar District Court offer age relaxation?
faq.answer: Yes, age relaxation is provided as per government rules. This includes relaxation for Chhattisgarh domicile, SC/ST/OBC candidates, and women candidates.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of the Baloda Bazar District Court, the link for which is provided in the Important Links section of this article.
